brief: Twenty new candidates following visual research: expressive C shapes, tangible dispatch objects, parallel motion, and new constructions.

concepts.name: Duet
concepts.idea: Two curves moving alongside one another.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original app-logo candidate for Codealong, a Mac app that gathers coding agents across tools and projects, shows their activity, and returns you to the right session. Brand idea: many agents moving together, with a capable friendly companion.
Composition: exactly ONE large centered standalone symbol on a fully opaque clean off-white square canvas, generous even margins, symbol roughly 65–72% of canvas. No contact sheet. No words, numbers, captions, watermark, mockup device, or UI. The symbol itself is the logo. Strong silhouette, simple enough to recognize at small size. Original design, do not reproduce existing brands.

Specific concept: Two separate supple curved ribbon strokes, one coral and one deep periwinkle, nest alongside each other to form a single open capital C. Both curves follow the same direction; one lightly overlaps at the lower bend. Expressive rounded ends, slightly asymmetric, balanced open center. Flat clean vector-like design, no gradients, no shadows, no app tile. Warm, playful, extremely simple.
